lines.sub: Ek ajeeb sa khilauna. Aur log iske liye ghanton line mein khade hain.
Nukeele kaan, 9 daant, shararati muskaan. Ise artist Kasing Lung ne ek kitaab ke liye banaya tha.
Phir China ki company Pop Mart ne ise blind box mein bechna shuru kiya.
Blind box matlab: kholne se pehle pata nahi kaun sa milega. To log baar-baar khareedte hain.
Phir Blackpink ki Lisa ne Labubu ke saath photo daali.
Celebrities ne ise mehenge bags par taangna shuru kiya. Lines, jhagde, aur kai guna resale keemat.
Pop Mart ki kamaai aur share, dono aasmaan par.
Sabak: log khilauna nahi, ehsaas khareedte hain: surprise, kami, aur status.
Aisi aur kahaniyon ke liye, follow karo!
